content: Sunita Agarwal confirmed the cancellation of Rohan Ahuja's home policy, noting it will be processed in 3–5 business days with a refund for the unused premium. Rohan thanked her and asked for the expected refund date and whether he will receive documentation confirming the cancellation.

action_items: Sunita to process the cancellation within 3–5 business days and issue the refund
Sunita to provide Rohan with the expected refund date and confirmation documentation
